rule: kept: in the compact set, the smallest feature set on the greedy backward path (chosen on the training perturbations' out-of-fold scores) whose score is within max(one paired SE, 0.001) of the path's best; a feature kept in the selected model's or the pool's compact set is not boxed. required_input: a feature that a kept feature computes through ctx.feature, directly or transitively (recorded while the kept feature is computed), whatever its own scores; it is not boxed either, since a lab that banned it could no longer compute the kept feature. unstable: its full-training block, computed again in three fresh processes under PYTHONHASHSEED 0, 1 and 2 by the audit's own plugin loading, differs between two of them by more than 1e-6 of a column's standard deviation (or in shape, or raises under some seeds only), so its values depend on Python's per-process str hash, and the run did not record the seed its experiment processes ran under (run.hash_seed, recorded since that seed was fixed) or the audit runs under another one, so no score of it can be reproduced; a feature that computes an unstable one through ctx.feature is unstable too. An unstable feature is left out of every score, path and compact set, so it is never kept and no kept feature needs it, and it is always boxed. A feature that depends on the seed in a run audited under the seed it recorded computes the lab's own values: it is listed (hash_check.seed_dependent) and audited as any other, unless a second process under that same seed computes its block differently too (hash_check.same_seed: it follows memory addresses, which no seed fixes), which makes it unstable there as well. Otherwise, in this order: harmful: dropping it from the full model raises the visible score by more than max(paired SE, 0.001); redundant: one of its columns correlates |r| >= 0.9 with a column of a kept feature (partner named); substitutable: dropping it from the full model lowers the visible score by more than max(paired SE, 0.001), yet the compact set does without it (kept features substitute for it); no_gain: any other feature outside the compact set (drop-one effect within max(paired SE, 0.001)); unrecomputable: it raised while being computed, or its plugin failed to import. Scores: pearson_delta per visible perturbation; each subset's ridge penalty chosen on the training perturbations' out-of-fold scores under one fold partition and reported under another, so only the validation perturbations are independent of it. 0.001 is a margin of practical equivalence, not a noise estimate. Built-in features are never boxed. Ties (training scores within 1e-9, as for exact duplicates) are broken by feature name: the forward path adds, and the backward path keeps, the feature first by name.
